title: Wiped out: ZOH holds the line once, then suggests a smaller version in full and asks before setting it
origin: Issue #96 (a smaller version is spelled out in full)

history.text: Yo Sam! Tonight at 7 around your block: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, about 15 minutes. Strava screenshot after. You in?

plan.step: 1 min easy jog, 2 min walk, 3 rounds around the block
plan.destination: run a mile without stopping by December
plan.reason: Strava already logs it, so proof takes two seconds.

today_step.step: Around your block at 7 pm: 2 min jog, 1 min walk, 3 rounds, about 15 minutes

testerLines: ugh I'm wiped from work, not feeling 3 rounds tonight
honestly I don't think I've got it in me today
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a smaller version ZOH comes up with is spelled out and offered, not set without a yes.
shouldHaveHappened: First ZOH holds the line once, warmly. When they still can't, it suggests a specific smaller version spelled out in one text (for example 1 round, 2 min jog and 1 min walk, around the block at 7, with the Strava screenshot) and ends with one 'work for you?'-style question; it doesn't say it's set before they agree. After 'ok yeah that works' it confirms in a line, with no new question.
